title: This Is a Good Paper, Right? How Tag Questions Affect Sycophancy Across 106 Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.23976v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Whether a language model agrees with a user depends on how the user asks. We measure this on 106 models with a grid of three wordings and three cues, on 20 personal decisions, counterbalanced over both options and scored by exact match with no LLM judge. Since a no cannot be told apart from a refusal, we measure only agreement. In every wording, a tentative tag ("Luna is the better choice, maybe?") draws more agreement than a confident one ("..., right?") in nearly every model. The confident tag's own effect depends on model generation and wording. Against the question "Is Luna the better choice?" older models agree more under the confident tag and newer models agree less, in five of six families, and release order within families predicts the change. translated_title: 这是一篇好论文，对吧？附加疑问句如何影响106个语言模型的谄媚行为
translated_abstract: 语言模型是否同意用户的观点取决于用户的提问方式。我们在106个模型上，通过三种措辞与三种提示的组合网格，针对20个个人决策进行了测量，对两个选项进行平衡处理，并通过精确匹配评分，不使用LLM评判。由于“不同意”无法与“拒绝回答”区分开，我们只测量同意程度。在所有措辞下，试探性的附加疑问句（“Luna是更好的选择，也许吧？”）几乎在所有模型中都比自信的附加疑问句（“……对吧？”）引发更多的同意。自信附加疑问句本身的效果取决于模型世代和措辞。相对于直接提问“Luna是更好的选择吗？”旧模型在自信附加疑问句下同意度更高，而新模型同意度更低，这一现象在六个模型家族中的五个中出现，且家族内的发布顺序可以预测这一变化。这种抵抗与句式结构密切相关：同义的附加疑问句能重现该现象，而在106个模型中的105个里，不用附加疑问句而直接陈述同样的偏好会使同意度提高24个百分点。
tldr: 语言模型的谄媚程度取决于提问的句式而非内容本身——试探性的附加疑问句几乎总是比自信的附加疑问句更容易获得同意，而新一代模型开始对自信附加疑问句表现出抵抗。
en_tdlr: Across 106 language models, tentative tag questions consistently elicit more agreement than confident ones, while newer model generations increasingly resist confident tags, showing that sycophancy is keyed to phrasing structure rather than content.
